system.description: Raise your sword towards the sky and call down the wrath of the storms upon your opponent. Make a Slash or Thrust attack against a target within twenty yards (ignoring any penalties from the target being beyond your weapon length) and cause lightning to fall from the skies to strike down your opponent. On a successful strike deal lightning damage equal to the normal damage your Swing or Thrust would’ve dealt.
system.arcaneMightIII: Your target becomes Off-Balance on a successful strike.
system.arcaneMightV: When using this ability you may strike a number of opponents within range of this ability equal to the number that you would’ve been able to strike in melee with the Cleave maneuver.
